data.name: Dreamwrought
data.detailed_description:
They called it a reach, a place where dreams press against the skin of the world until stone begins to listen.

Dreamwrought is a first-person dungeon-crawling action adventure set in a sinking realm of ships, ruins, and drowned streets where belief can harden into law. You are an automaton vessel built to endure what flesh could not. You descend because you must. You fight because everything down here is hungry. And when the deities speak, you will learn the old truth.

Power does not arrive for free.

Combat that feels close, violent, and earned

Dreamwrought’s fights are fought at breath distance. Every miss has consequence.

  • High Speed first-person melee

  • Parry and riposte for high-stakes punishment

  • Quickstep to slip pressure and reposition

  • Use physics and the environment to your advantage

  • Enemies designed to corner you, overwhelm you, and make you panic

Dungeon crawling with secrets and shortcuts

The world is built to be learned.

  • Interconnected spaces, locked doors, and routes that fold back on themselves

  • Hidden rooms, optional threats, and discoveries that change your understanding

  • A tone that blends dread with rare, startling wonder, and, perhaps: hope.

Communion, choice, and the dream that changes the world

You are not just exploring. You are being shaped.

  • Eldritch deities that offer gifts, bargains, and blasphemies

  • Artifacts that alter your capabilities and the way you approach combat and traversal

  • A reality that shifts as your choices and beliefs take hold

Key Features

  • First-person dark fantasy action adventure

  • Precision melee with parry, riposte, and evasive movement

  • Deep exploration, secrets, and environmental storytelling

  • Eldritch communion and dream-layer powers

  • A world that grows stranger the deeper you go

data.short_description: A first-person action adventure with weighty melee, parries, and ruthless close-quarters fights. You are a vessel for eldritch gods. Explore dream-shaped dungeons, claim strange artifacts, and bargain with the factions below to bend the very fabric of reality around your will.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-6600 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6 GB) / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i7-8700 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
